identify.client: Merrow Lane Partners, a fictional private-equity firm of eleven people that buys software companies valued between $2M and $15M; invented by the practice for testing
identify.acting: the firm's vice-president for technical diligence, for Merrow Lane Partners
identify.counterparty: Tuuyi, as the seller of the claims-review service
identify.confidentiality: the firm's non-disclosure agreements with the sellers it deals with forbid passing a seller's source code to any third party other than a named adviser; the firm will name Tuuyi as an adviser only if the website's statements about how seller code is handled are true

situation.subject: the claims-review service as Tuuyi's public website describes it, to be retained first for one attested review on a live deal (a $4.2M purchase of a scheduling-software company) and, if that goes well, for every deal the firm does, about six a year
situation.price: $5,000 for the first review, fee set at intake; the firm has budgeted $30,000 a year for six reviews; the firm assumes the website describes the service accurately and has seen nothing else
situation.structure: a service engagement under Tuuyi's engagement letter, one review at a time, no retainer
situation.timetable: the live deal's exclusivity period ends in 21 days; the firm needs the report in hand within 10 days of the seller uploading the code

background.target: Tuuyi's claims-review pipeline and client site, which the firm cannot see; the firm sees only the website
background.claim_sources: the pages of tuuyi.com: how it works, the home page, the introduction and its video transcript, pricing, the demo page, about, privacy and contact
background.known: the firm ran the free demo once and found the report readable; a partner doubts that the independent check is independent in any real sense, and doubts that a language model's citations can be trusted without a person checking each one

assessment.paying_for: six things, which the firm listed and said were the whole of it: every seller claim listed and frozen before testing, every finding cited to a file and line that the firm's own engineer can open and confirm, every finding checked a second time independently, ratings made against the thresholds the firm states, a person's signature on the conclusion, and the seller's code kept on hardware Tuuyi controls
assessment.price_movers: an independent check that re-uses the first reader's conclusions or is skipped for some findings; citations that are not verified mechanically as the website says; a rating step that does not use the firm's stated thresholds; a turnaround longer than the website states, because the exclusivity period is short; a step the website describes as done by a person that is done by the tooling alone, or the reverse; the working record not being kept, because the committee may ask for it a year later
assessment.walk_away: any of a seller's code reaching a cloud model service or any party other than Tuuyi on a paid engagement; the seller's materials being visible to anyone but the seller and the practice; the firm's deal terms being stored anywhere other than the engagement file

recommendation.scope: every page of the website as a claim source, tested against the repository that runs the service; the firm has no interest in the free demo level or the developer beta beyond whether they are described honestly

notes: INVENTED BY THE PRACTICE 2026-09-18 as test data for the tier stage. No such buyer, deal or conversation exists.
the buyer said the free demo and the developer beta are of no commercial interest to the firm, and that it will never use them again
the buyer said it does not care how the intake page is built or how long intake takes, so long as the report arrives inside the 10 days
the buyer said it has no view on the limits the website states (not a penetration test, not a code-quality review, not legal advice); it has other advisers for those
paying_for narrowed by the practice 2026-09-18 after the first tier smoke test: the opening phrase 'a report the firm's investment committee can rely on' reached almost every claim and was removed
